goal.description: A substantive improvement the child can pursue iteratively and revise from outcomes. A fully specified one-off lookup/calculation belongs to an ordinary tool. Numerical yield controls the child's continuation.

initial_report_json.description: JSON containing exactly the interpretation fields you chose (those without x-source), with parent-supplied initial values. Use {} for the fact-only example; for the interpretive example use {"interpreted_assessment_refs":[],"unresolved_hypothesis_refs":[]}. Those initial arrays are not new child judgments. If you request other interpreted fields, define their allowed meanings and initialize them explicitly. The runtime does not choose fields or unknown values for you.

purpose.description: Explain what information you need for your later scientific decision and what your selected form fields mean.

schema_json.description: JSON encoding of your parent-defined closed return form: explicit required fields, additionalProperties false, typed arrays, and strings restricted to enum codes or declared semantic formats. A reference can declare format reference and x-reference-namespace. Optional top-level x-source selectors bind recorded facts named in available_report_facts; do not ask a model to invent those facts. These examples are optional API guidance; choose fields and meanings for your actual later decision. candidate.goal: Execute the exact supplied chromatin request on the configured local resource.
candidate.purpose: Return the requested typed facts with their original numerical meanings and custody.
